name: 32195-multilora-gptoss120b-2gpu
hardware: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 on one node, sm90.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, EP off, one engine on one node: eight resident rank-32 adapter slots plus the mxfp4 expert weights do not fit one 80 GB card.
architecture: Sparse mixture-of-experts decoder (GptOssForCausalLM), 36 layers, 128 experts with 4 active per token, mxfp4 expert weights -- read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, 200 requests, 1800 s safety cap, static seed 32195; keep the stream count between 4 and 16.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, temperature 0, `ignore_eos` with a hard `max_tokens`: ~1600 prompt tokens (1520-1680) and ~400 output tokens (380-420), every request tagged with one of the eight adapter names registered in `scenario.json`.
purpose: A 120-billion-parameter assistant serving eight specialized teams via their own adapters, handling long document prompts at eight concurrent streams across two GPUs.
launch:
# Every key here goes into AsyncEngineArgs; an unknown key is an error at engine construction.
# Adapter names are NOT engine arguments here -- `--lora-modules` belongs to the API server, and
# the tag is a property of a request, so the names are declared client-side in
# `scenario.json` `spec.backend.lora_modules`.

model: openai/gpt-oss-120b
tensor-parallel-size: 2
enable-lora: true
max-loras: 8
max-lora-rank: 32
max-num-seqs: 8
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95
enable-prefix-caching: false
trust-remote-code: true
max-model-len: 4096
